compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

`reconcile-check` exposes discrepancies, orphaned rebar/Jira bindings, unbound counts, checked/in-sync totals, formatting, exit behavior, and persisted report output. Its replacement cannot be guessed from command spelling: field-diff information belongs with preview, integrity/bindings with fsck, and operational witnesses with status.

## Approach

Enumerate each current observable and assign it to `bridge preview`, `bridge fsck`, or `bridge status`. Implement a new well-named bridge diagnostic subverb only if an observable does not coherently fit those owners. Migrate report persistence away from `bridge_state/reconcile-check.json` while proving parity or recording explicit retirement for every field.

## Scope

- reconcile-check report construction and direct-engine output
- bridge preview/fsck/status command/result contracts
- persisted bridge-state reports, docs, and characterization tests

## Testing

Use characterization fixtures for healthy, discrepant, orphaned, and unbound state; compare fields, formatting, exits, and persistence before/after canonical bridge routing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every reconcile-check observable has a documented canonical bridge owner or an explicit approved retirement.
- [ ] Preview exposes field-diff observations; fsck exposes binding/integrity diagnostics; status exposes operational witnesses.
- [ ] Any new bridge diagnostic subverb has one coherent responsibility and a stable named result contract.
- [ ] Persisted report behavior is migrated from `bridge_state/reconcile-check.json` with field/exit/format parity or explicit retirement evidence.
- [ ] Characterization and canonical bridge tests cover healthy, discrepant, orphaned, and unbound cases.
